item.text: {"search_note":"I ran a bounded pass with multiple query formulations and found a mostly de-escalatory record, but not a clean one. The strongest 2024 evidence favors diplomacy and compromise; the main counterevidence is Sharif’s own UNGA rhetoric, which paired dialogue calls with hard warnings. I found no 2024 evidence that force was his preferred first option in the sense of an actual military first strike or rejection of talks. The record is mostly rhetorical, and the rhetoric tilts toward diplomacy with a meaningful coercive overlay.","evidence":[{"title":"Peace in South Asia depends on settlement of Kashmir dispute: PM","publisher":"Radio Pakistan","date":"2024-09-21","url":"https://www.radio.gov.pk/21-09-2024/peace-in-south-asia-depends-on-settlement-of-kashmir-dispute-pm","summary":"Sharif said Pakistan strongly believes in peace and stability through dialogue, and that lasting regional peace depends on a peaceful settlement of Kashmir.
